items.title: Foot Physiotherapy
items.desc: Professional treatment for foot, ankle and bone pain. Advanced methods for pain relief and rehabilitation.

items.title: Lower Back Pain
items.desc: Diagnosis and treatment of lower back pain related to posture and gait issues. Personalised rehabilitation for every patient.

items.title: Post-Surgery Rehabilitation
items.desc: Professional support throughout recovery after foot, knee and hip surgeries. Safe and rapid return to activity.

items.title: Sports Injuries
items.desc: Treatment of sports injuries: sprains, tears and muscle fatigue. Fast return to training routines.

items.title: Orthopedic Insoles
items.desc: Custom-made orthopedic insoles tailored to foot structure, for improved posture and pain prevention.

items.title: Gait Analysis
items.desc: Advanced computerized gait analysis to identify imbalances, body rotations and biomechanical issues.
